clauses.quote: In the event a change must be made during the summer or fall, administration must show documentation to the Executive Director of the Association and the affected teacher justifying the change.
teachers shall not, under normal conditions, be assigned outside the scope of their teaching licenses and endorsements.
District seniority of teachers shall be considered for purposes of school assignment, schedule, program, or grade level.
All regular contract teachers at a school site shall have the opportunity to apply for reassignment to any available position at the school site, prior to the position being filled.
clauses.subject_text: All regular contract teachers at a school site

clauses.quote: Changes in teaching assignments during the school year should be avoided
clauses.subject_text: Changes in teaching assignments during the school year

clauses.quote: Appropriate disciplinary measures should be assessed to students when students make false allegations against an employee that have an affect or impact on the teacher’s employment.
Teachers shall report in writing, as soon as possible to their principal/supervisor, any assault suffered in connection with their employment.
The principal/supervisor will forward a copy to School Leadership and Improvement.
The Superintendent and a law enforcement agency shall be notified of any such assault.
clauses.subject_text: The Superintendent and a law enforcement agency

If the teacher is found guilty or liable in such proceedings, such finding shall constitute a cause for dismissal from the school system.
